items.t: 2027 GRIs: 5.9% again; UPS takes effect Dec. 21, 2026
items.body: FedEx announced its 2027 increase on Sept. 18, 2026, at an average 5.9% effective Jan. 4, 2027. That is the fourth straight 5.9% headline, after 2024, 2025 and 2026. The 2018 FedEx increase was 4.9% (announced Sept. 18, 2017, effective Jan. 1, 2018) and the 2023 increase was 6.9%. UPS announced its 5.9% on Oct. 23, 2026, effective Dec. 21, 2026. Its 2018 increase was 4.9%, announced Oct. 25, 2017 and effective Dec. 24, 2017. Its 2019 increase was announced Dec. 5, 2018, about 3 weeks before the Dec. 26 effective date.

items.t: USPS pairs 5.9% average rise with permanent 11% fuel charge
items.body: USPS filed on Nov. 12, 2026 for a 5.9% average increase on four domestic package services and an 11% fuel surcharge, both scheduled for Jan. 17, 2027 pending Postal Regulatory Commission review. The fuel charge would replace the temporary 8% transportation-related increase that took effect Apr. 26, 2026 (announced Mar. 25, 2026). In January 2026 (announced Nov. 14, 2025) Priority Mail rose about 6.6% and Ground Advantage about 7.8%. In January 2025 (announced Nov. 15, 2024) they rose 3.2% and 3.9%. In January 2021 USPS noted it had no fuel surcharge.

items.t: Surcharges rise faster than headline GRI; size triggers change
items.body: An analysis published Nov. 6, 2026 says all 20 of the most common UPS surcharges rise more than the 5.9% average, averaging 9.1%. The UPS Ground residential surcharge went from $6.10 to $6.50 in the 2026 increase (effective Dec. 22, 2025) and from $4.45 to $4.85 in the 2022 increase. FedEx's 2027 list moves Additional Handling from $29.50-$40.75 to $31.75-$43.75 by zone, against $28-$38 for AHS-Dimension in 2025. In 2026 FedEx (Jan. 12) and UPS (Jan. 26) added cubic-volume triggers, including more than 10,368 cubic inches for Additional Handling.

items.t: UPS fuel tables changed five times in 2026 domestic cycles
items.body: UPS domestic fuel tables rose effective Jan. 5, Mar. 9 (reported as the third UPS fuel increase of 2026), Aug. 10 and Nov. 2, 2026. The tables announced Nov. 12 take effect Nov. 16 and add 0.50 point per price band over the Nov. 2 tables. In 2025 UPS made domestic table changes effective Mar. 10 (+0.50), May 26 (+1.00) and Jun. 23 (Air +0.75), when UPS and FedEx Ground both reached a then-record 20%. In November 2026 the UPS flyer lists Ground at 30.00% for diesel $6.25-$6.34, and TheStreet reported FedEx's fuel surcharge at 30.5%. FedEx also changed its domestic tables effective Nov. 9, 2026.

items.t: 2026 peak add-ons exceed 2025 levels at FedEx, UPS and USPS
items.body: FedEx announced its 2026 demand surcharges on July 22, 2026 (2025: July 8). For Nov. 23-Dec. 27 they include Additional Handling $11.85 (2025: $10.90), Oversize $117.25 ($108.50) and Ground residential $0.80 ($0.65). UPS lists Large Package at $117.50 in its peak window (2025: $107) and Over Maximum Limits at $590 ($540). USPS peak runs Oct. 4, 2026-Jan. 17, 2027, stacked on the temporary 8%, with retail Zone 1-4 0-3 lb parcels at +$0.50 versus +$0.40 in 2025 and +$0.30 in 2024. FedEx's 2018 peak Additional Handling add-on was $3.20.

items.t: Per-pound surge fees are new in 2026; several are open-ended
items.body: UPS added a $1.34 per lb U.S.-Middle East surge fee on Mar. 22 and a $0.23 per lb fee on most international lanes on Apr. 19, 2026. FedEx added Zone K demand fees on Mar. 5 ($0.50 per lb export, $0.70 import) and Vietnam-origin fees effective Nov. 2 ($0.36 priority, $0.27 economy). UPS announced on Nov. 12 that China/Hong Kong/Macau fees rise from $0.91 to $1.03 per lb effective Nov. 16. In 2025 per-lb international fees of $0.10 to $0.52 ran within dated peak windows; several 2026 fees run until further notice.
